newsitem.title: UGANDA: Kampala grenade attacks kill nine.
newsitem.headline: Kampala grenade attacks kill nine.

text.p: The third grenade attack in the Ugandan capital in three days has pushed the death toll to nine, police said on Saturday.
A grenade thrown by a motorcyclist late on Friday exploded at Nakulabye police post, killing the eight-year-old daughter of a police officer and injuring four police officers and three civilians.
Inspector General of Police Cossy Odomel called the attackers hard core criminals retaliating for a police crackdown. "It's nothing political, they are not urban terrorists," he said.

Police on Friday defused a bomb near Kampala's Pride Theatre while on Wednesday attackers hurled a grenade at a taxi, a second at a police car and a third into a crowd at Kampala's Kibuye suburb, killing eight and injuring 45.
A grenade was also thrown at policemen in Natete on Thursday evening, but exploded harmlessly. Spokesman Bob Ngobi said police made six arrests.
